Red Bull needed a stage that could handle real-time fan interaction, massive LED displays, and a rotating lineup of country music stars—all in one night at Ascend Amphitheater.

THE SOLUTION

I translated bold creative concepts from Lumenati into fabrication-ready technical documentation:

→ Monumental LED arch spanning the full stage width
→ Layered façade components for depth and visual impact
→ Precision CNC drawings for steel and aluminum construction
→ Modular design for efficient transport and on-site assembly

THE PROCESS

Using Vectorworks, I created comprehensive technical documentation:

• Elevation and section drawings with exact dimensions
• CNC layout files optimized for routing efficiency
• Material specifications (aluminum panels, MDF substrates)
• Component labeling and assembly sequencing
• Coordination with truss systems and LED integration

THE RESULT

A monumental stage installation that brought Red Bull Jukebox to life—6,800 fans controlling the music in real time under a stunning LED arch.
